prompt:
You are a staff software architect. Write a concise, architecture-first technical proposal for the following client job posting.

Client: GeoInsight Analytics
Title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Geospatial Analytics Platform
Description: We need an end-to-end geospatial analytics dashboard that ingests municipal parcel and zoning datasets, runs spatial joins and proximity analysis on a PostGIS backend, and renders interactive choropleth maps for urban planners. The existing system is a Django monolith with slow ad-hoc SQL, no caching, and 8+ second query times on large parcels.
Budget: $90k-$120k | Timeline: 16 weeks
chosen: GeoInsight's bottleneck is slow spatial SQL, not front-end rendering. Fix the data layer first: a PostGIS schema with GiST indexes, ST_DWithin pipelines, and Redis-cached tiles. Serve them from a Next.js App Router layer with React Server Components. Milestones: schema + indexes (weeks 1-4), Node.js API (5-8), map UI + caching (9-12), hardening + CI/CD (13-16). This cuts query time roughly 10x with a sub-500ms tile p95.
rejected: In today's fast-paced digital landscape, cutting-edge innovation is paramount for any organization seeking to remain competitive. We leverage best-in-class synergies to deliver a seamless, world-class solution that is robust, scalable, and future-proof. Our holistic, end-to-end approach harnesses state-of-the-art technologies to drive transformative outcomes, empower stakeholders, and unlock unprecedented value while maximizing ROI. We are passionate about excellence and relentlessly committed to exceeding expectations at every touchpoint, ensuring an intuitive and delightful user experience that aligns seamlessly with your long-term strategic vision for data-driven disruption and success.

You are a staff software architect. Write a concise, architecture-first technical proposal for the following client job posting.

Client: PulseLogix
Title: Backend Engineer - Serverless Observability Pipeline
Description: We are building a real-time observability platform that ingests millions of events per day from customer SDKs, normalizes them, and triggers alerting and anomaly detection rules. The current pipeline is a brittle batch ETL job that drops events under load.
Budget: $70k-$95k | Timeline: 12 weeks
chosen: PulseLogix's bottleneck is the batch ETL that drops events under load. Replace it with a serverless event-driven pipeline: API Gateway/Kinesis into Lambda processors, Step Functions for orchestration, DynamoDB for hot storage, and S3 + Athena for cold analytics. Add dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers for zero-loss guarantees. Milestones: ingestion (1-3w), processing + state machines (4-7w), storage + analytics (8-10w), chaos/load testing (11-12w). Reproducible Terraform from day one.

Client: AgentForge
Title: ML Engineer - LLM Agent Automation Pipeline
Description: We need an LLM agent pipeline that automates customer support triage, ticket summarization, and knowledge-base drafting. The agent must use retrieval-augmented generation over internal docs, function calling into our CRM and ticketing APIs, and guardrails to prevent hallucinated actions.
Budget: $120k-$150k | Timeline: 20 weeks
chosen: AgentForge's bottleneck is uncontrolled tool calls and generic tone. Build a LangGraph orchestration with a RAG retriever over internal docs (pgvector), a constrained function-calling layer scoped to CRM/ticketing actions, and a guardrail validator that blocks unsafe calls. Add a LoRA fine-tuning loop on win/loss pairs to imprint brand voice, plus an offline eval harness. Milestones: RAG + evals (1-4w), tool layer + guardrails (5-9w), agent orchestration (10-14w), fine-tuning loop (15-20w).

Client: UrbanPulse
Title: Geospatial Backend Engineer - Municipal Spatial Data
Description: We provide municipalities with a spatial data API for zoning, flood-risk, and transport planning. We need a high-performance PostGIS backend that exposes GeoJSON APIs, supports dynamic tiling, and handles concurrent spatial queries over tens of millions of geometries.
Budget: $80k-$100k | Timeline: 14 weeks

Move heavy joins into materialized views refreshed by ETL. Milestones: schema + index audit (1-3w), query optimization (4-7w), tile + API service (8-11w), containerization + tenancy (12-14w). Targets a p95 under 300ms.
